name: AUIB Society of Arts and Letters

meta.source: SAL-BRD-01 Brand & Identity v3 (PDF, Draft 1, 28 Sep 2026)

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Primary. The symbol, titles, bands. 7.8:1 on `white`, 7.3:1 on `paper`, 6.7:1 on `crimson-50`: any size. Never text or the symbol on `ink` (1.7:1).

tokens.name: crimson-700
tokens.usage: The wordmarks on light grounds (10.1:1 on `white`); pressed states; fine print on tint (8.8:1 on `crimson-50`).

tokens.name: crimson-100
tokens.usage: The wordmarks on `crimson` (5.2:1) and `ink` (8.8:1); lines and kickers on `ink`.

tokens.name: crimson-50
tokens.usage: Cards, notes, highlights. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-70` or `crimson`; not `ink-50` (4.0:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, dark pages, the Open Call. 13.2:1 with `white` either way round.

tokens.name: ink-70
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `white` (7.7:1) and `crimson-50` (6.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-50
tokens.usage: Captions and meta only, 8 pt and up, on `white` (4.6:1). Fails on `paper` (4.3:1) and `crimson-50` (4.0:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Paper for everything; text on `ink` and `crimson`.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Waraq's warm page only. `ink` (12.3:1) and `crimson` (7.3:1) read on it.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Table row hairlines (measured from the guide's tables, not a named palette colour). Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. White pages; ink for the 'why' pages (mission, preamble, the case for the Society).

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Cards and notes on `surface`. `white` reads 7.7:1 on its dark value.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and headings on `surface` and `surface-tint`: 11.4:1 or better in light, 7.7:1 or better in dark.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface` and `surface-tint`. On ink the guide names only white text, so dark stays `white`.

tokens.name: text-meta
tokens.usage: Captions, footers, page numbers on `surface` only (4.6:1 light, 8.8:1 dark). Light value fails on `surface-tint`: use `text-secondary` there.

tokens.name: title
tokens.usage: Section titles in Display on `surface`. White on ink, because crimson on ink fails (1.7:1).

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Header rules, the crimson rule under table heads, kickers, on `surface`.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Full-bleed footer and contents bands. At most one per page.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text on `band` (7.8:1).

styles.name: print-display
styles.usage: 58 pt, the top of the 42–58 pt range. Cover titles and section titles in `title`. Leading measured from the cover.

styles.name: print-lede
styles.sample: Our own photos of our own people, taken with consent, always beat stock images.
styles.usage: 17 pt, top of 14–17 pt. One sentence under a title. Leading measured.

styles.name: print-heading
styles.usage: 18 pt, top of 11.5–18 pt. Headings within a page.

styles.name: print-body
styles.sample: SAL is what members already call us. Three letters, no translation needed, legible at the size of a coin.
styles.usage: 10.5 pt, top of 9–10.5 pt, 1.5 leading. Short lines, plain words.

styles.name: print-caption
styles.sample: Build: circle in Crimson; inner ring at 7% inset.
styles.usage: 8.5 pt, top of 7.5–8.5 pt, in `text-meta`. Leading measured.

styles.name: print-kicker
styles.usage: Tracked capitals above headings, in `accent-line`. Size and tracking measured from the guide (about 7.8 pt); set in uppercase.

styles.name: post-display
styles.usage: Top of 118–132 px. A two- or three-word headline with a full stop.

styles.name: post-lede
styles.sample: A journal read blind and printed with care.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Document codes, form numbers, clause numbers, six-word pages. 9 pt, as on the guide's cover.

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Arabic titles beside `print-display`. Set at the same size; the 1.4 leading leaves room for Arabic ascenders. Bold.

styles.name: ar-heading
styles.usage: Arabic headings beside `print-heading`, one step larger (19 pt).

styles.name: ar-body
styles.usage: Arabic body beside `print-body`: 10 pt, one step larger than English at the same reading size, leading 1.8–2.0.

styles.name: ar-caption
styles.usage: The Arabic name under document codes and in footers, beside `code` and `print-caption` (9 pt).

styles.name: ar-post
styles.usage: The one line of Arabic at the bottom right of every post, one step above `post-body`.

spacing.note: Measured from the guide's page layouts (it states no spacing scale).

tokens.name: gap-tight
tokens.usage: Gap between swatches and between the Key page's cards (4 mm).

tokens.name: card-padding
tokens.usage: Inner padding of cards on `surface-tint`.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Gap between document-part cards and lockup tiles (5 mm).

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: A4 page side margins (21 mm).

radius.note: Measured from the guide (it states no radii).

tokens.name: radius-swatch
tokens.usage: Colour swatches and small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and notes on `surface-tint`.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: The Key's circle. Never another shape.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Table rules (`rule`, `accent-line` under heads) and the crimson header rule on forms. Measured.
